message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are visible in any of the shown code paths; data is passed directly from get_RICH into DataLoader without validation.
No detected untrusted source handling: The data path is read from config and passed to get_RICH with no checksum verification, signature checks, or authenticated retrieval visible in the shown code.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution checks, label value validation, or label-noise detection tools (e.g., Cleanlab) are present anywhere in the visible code.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation path (get_RICH and DataLoader setup) contains no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code instantiates models directly from class constructors (JSGAN, WGAN, CramerGAN) and saves checkpoints via `gan_model.save_models()`, but there is no loading of pretrained weights and no hash/signature verification of any serialized model artifacts.

No detected label distribution validation: The code loads the dataset via get_RICH and passes it directly to DataLoader without any label distribution check, class balance validation, or anomaly detection on training samples.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: The training loop in trainer.py contains no backdoor defenses such as trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection.
No detected differential privacy: There is no use of Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, or any other differential privacy mechanism in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the evaluation pipeline.

No detected metric tampering protection: Evaluation uses a validation_loader that is derived from the same get_RICH pipeline without any hashing, signing, or isolation guarantees, and only a single rocauc metric is logged with no cross-validation or independent test set separation.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path (calculate_inference_time and fit) passes tensors directly to the model without any shape, range, or schema validation.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs from generator_model and train_*/evaluate calls are used directly with no NaN guards, range checks, or sanity bounds applied.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a GAN-based pipeline (WGAN/JSGAN/CramerGAN), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
